title: Precision Solid
lines: The Precision core was designed with the possibility to create both single density and dual density versions and it takes versatility to a whole new level.
With these possibilities, the Precision offers the widest variety of RG, Differential, and Intermediate Differential combinations ever assembled into one single design.
In this single density version, the low RG, combined with high differential and a large mass bias, allows the Precision to change direction very quickly down lane.
